import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from plan_graph import build_arcs
from ns2 import NetworkSimplex
from fractions import Fraction
random.seed(3)
S=100;J=300;F=8;G=6
slots=[];t=0
for s in range(S):
    t += random.randint(0,10)
    slots.append([t,random.randint(0,5),0 if s==0 else random.randint(0,5)])
flows=[]
for f in range(F):
    flows.append([random.randint(1,8),random.randint(20,80),random.randrange(G) if G else -1,random.randrange(7)])
groups=[]
for g in range(G):
    groups.append([-1 if g==0 else random.randrange(g), random.randint(10,200)])
wins=[]
for j in range(J):
    f=random.randrange(F)
    ready=random.randint(0,max(0,t//2))
    expires=random.randint(max(ready,t//2),t)
    wins.append([f,ready,expires,random.randint(1,65535),random.randint(1,320),0,random.randint(1,1000),[[0,0]]*9])
case={'model':'cnn','class_values':[random.randint(1,1000) for _ in range(7)],'stats':[1,1,75],'bucket':[512,512],'slots':slots,'flows':flows,'groups':groups,'windows':wins}
preds=[random.randrange(7) for _ in wins]
th=[65535]*J
r=Fraction(0)
K,R,Z,a,b,e,w,z,h,arcs=build_arcs(case,preds,th,r)
print('K,E',K,len(arcs))
f0=[l for u,v,l,h,c in arcs]
t0=time.time(); ns=NetworkSimplex(K,arcs,f0);print('init',time.time()-t0,'interior?')
t0=time.time();ns.solve(verbose=True);print('solve',time.time()-t0,'iters',ns.iters,'degen',ns.degenerate)
print('obj',ns.objective(),'selected',sum(1 for i,(u,v,l,h,c) in enumerate(arcs) if u in set(e) and v in set(w) and ns.flow[i]>0))
